source.title: fix(roadmap): count the tokens of each implement Job once (#4213)

criteria: A test runs two Jobs for one item (the first killed, the second a continuation) and checks that the counter grows by the tokens of each Job once.
A retry by a person, which clears `implement.spend`, does not make the counter step back or lose tokens.
The record keys stay documented in `docs/ROADMAP_WORKFLOW.md`, and the invariant test in `tests/invariants/test_roadmap_implement_record_keys.py` names a reader for any new key.
